parameters.query:
update discovery_checkpoints
set
  last_successful_run = now(),
  last_successful_publication_date = greatest(
    coalesce(last_successful_publication_date, date '1900-01-01'),
    (select max(publication_date) from papers)
  ),
  updated_at = now()
where id = 1;
